breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt specified a time domain of t in [0, 1.0] but requested an output at T=1.1. The ground truth corrected this by requesting the output at T=1.0. The agent correctly identified this inconsistency and set the final time to T=1.0 in both the main problem description and the output requirements section, aligning perfectly with the ground truth.
